name: cove-mcp
description: The first CLI and MCP server for Cove Data Protection — fleet-wide backup health, billing usage, and storage trends from a terminal, with the local history the vendor console doesn't keep.

cove_partner.title: Cove customer/partner
cove_partner.description: The full customer/partner string exactly as it appears in the Cove console dropdown, including the parenthesised email, e.g. 'Acme Corp (admin@example.com)'. API users require it, and a wrong format returns the same error as a bad password.

cove_password.title: Cove API token
cove_password.description: API token issued with the Cove API user. Cove shows it once, at creation.

cove_username.title: Cove API user login
cove_username.description: Login name of the Cove API user (Cove console: Settings > API users). This is the API user's login, not your console email.

cove_base_url.title: Cove Data Protection API base URL
cove_base_url.description: Base URL for the Cove Data Protection API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only for tenant-gated multi-client deployments: binds the MCP server to an existing Printing Press client profile. Leave blank for a single-tenant install.

cove_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
cove_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing execute call. Leave blank to keep the local snapshot tools available.

cove_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
cove_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and the response cache is off. Leave blank to keep the local snapshot history.

cove_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
cove_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

cove_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
cove_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Cove requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.
